n = int(input())

mod1 = 998244353
mod2 = 10**9 + 7
base = 1000000

sum_list = [0] * 7
cnt = 0
ans = 0

def explore1(level, prefix):
    global cnt
    cnt += 1
    v[level].append((cnt - prefix) % mod1)
    sum_list[level] = (sum_list[level] + (cnt - prefix) % mod1) % mod2
    if level == 6:
        return
    for digit in range(10):
        explore1(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit)

def lower_bound(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr)
    while left < right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        if arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid
    return left

def explore2(x):
    global cnt, ans
    if x > n:
        return
    if x * base + base - 1 <= n and x * base * 10 > n:
        currentCount = cnt
        for i in range(7):
            size = len(v[i])
            difference = ((currentCount - x * (10 ** i)) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1
            position = lower_bound(v[i], (mod1 - difference) % mod1)
            ans = (ans + difference * size + sum_list[i]) % mod2
            ans = (ans - (mod1 * (size - position)) % mod2 + mod2) % mod2
            cnt += size
        return
    cnt += 1
    ans = (ans + ((cnt - x) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2
    for digit in range(10):
        explore2(x * 10 + digit)
